links.outcome: ChatGPT diagnostic and treatment recommendation accuracy and response time versus five physiatrists on same scenarios
links.effect: 91% of ChatGPT responses entirely accurate; 8% incomplete; mean answer time 2.3 ± 0.76 min for ChatGPT versus 5.4 ± 2.45 min for clinicians (p < 0.001).
links.quote: ChatGPT exhibited a high degree of diagnostic accuracy, with 91% of responses being entirely accurate.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing ChatGPT-4's diagnostic and management accuracy and response times across 100 clinical scenarios against five physiatrists; it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
